verdict.rationale: GitCafe's repository rulesets include a Code owners rule: each changed path needs approval from one of its owners listed in CODEOWNERS. Rulesets can require pull requests and reviews on matching branches, and can run in an Evaluate (warning-only) mode before enforcement. This directly delivers path-scoped code-owner approval. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation detail on CODEOWNERS syntax (e.g. team owners, file location).
